req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that all echo endpoints should return a JSON content type. This is crucial for clients expecting JSON responses. The test suite will verify this behavior across different HTTP methods and ensure that the content type is correctly set. It will also check for proper handling of errors and boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_get_endpoint_returns_json
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /get endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/get')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

tests.name: test_post_endpoint_with_invalid_method
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /post endpoint.
expected: The response status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed).
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/post')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_patch_endpoint_boundary_case
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a PATCH request to the /patch endpoint with minimal data.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.patch('/patch', data='{}')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'
